reasoning: This is the standard automotive dashboard glyph for directing HVAC airflow to both the windshield defroster and the floor/footwell vents. It fits a narrow but real set of vehicle maintenance tasks around car heaters, defrosters, cabin air filters, and blend door actuators, though at very small sizes the defroster symbol above the arrow could be misread as an overhead light or shower.
